instruction: the user stopped v4 on 2026-09-26 ('24 h is not needed; look from 5 days, better 10-14') and instructed 'go to v5'; Head DS wrote the plan; criteria frozen before the first fit
amended_before_fit: changed by the user before any fit (2026-09-26): instead of 72 fits (4 horizons x 3 sets x 3 seeds x 2 folds, target all episodes) only 10 fits with one seed (17) on the '>= 2 s' target at 10 and 14 days; because one seed gives no noise estimate the criterion is model vs static list and persistence; set comparisons with F2 are exploration only; the 'all episodes' stage and other horizons with a model only after the user's decision on these results
basis: TUNING_V4.md (stopped; partial fold 2023: F2 0.126, +W 0.136, +E 0.107, +R 0.115, +all 0.108 at 24 h) and reports/sensor-failure-v4-prep-2026-09-26.json
interpretation: registered loss of connection ('Неисправен', organizer: loss of connection with the device); not a confirmed breakdown; alarm is not a confirmed failure

all.role: stage 0; the model stage 'all episodes' waits for the user's decision

ge2s.role: stage 0 and stage 1 (the threshold the user means)

issue: daily at 00:00 local; unit A card = object_id x sensor_type (one model for all sensor types; sensor and system types are features)

policies.main: rolling list with release: a card is open for D days (D = window of the horizon) and leaves the list when its event starts inside the window; the place is free from the next cutoff; about one new card a day: at most D open
policies.extra: the same policy with at most 5 open
policies.reference: the same budgets without release (rolling list of v2-v4)
policies.definition: sensor_failure_nodes.select_rolling_release; precision and recall of an issued card use its own window

fold_note: embargo = horizon (fit cutoffs whose window crosses the fit/evaluate boundary are dropped); calibration and holdout are not read; no final stage
fit_rows: as v2-v4: candidate rows with a known label of the horizon, all positives plus the deterministic 10% hash sample of negatives weighted 10 before Balanced weighting; rows ordered by (channel_id, issued_at) so a fit is reproducible for a seed and thread count

stage0.grid: thresholds {> 2 s, >= 2 s, all} x horizons {5, 7, 10, 14 days} x budgets {D open, 5 open} x {with release, without release}
stage0.measures: events, base rate of evaluable cards, ceiling (greedy oracle under the same policy), persistence and static list P/R, median lead of captured events, new cards per day and per window

stage1.why_sel: v4 groups W, K, S, T, N; E and R excluded before v5 fits by the partial v4 result (both below F2 on fold 2023)
stage1.features: F2 = artifacts/sensor-failure-v1/features (00:00); v4 groups = artifacts/sensor-failure-v1/features_v4 (the same 00:00 cutoffs, point in time)
stage1.optional: for the same models, the policy with at most 5 open (no refit)
not_now: F2+sel-rank (E and S as within-day ranks): next step
models on the 'all episodes' target and on 5 and 7 days: after the user's decision

criteria.main: per horizon and model: card precision above the static list of last year under the main policy with the week-block paired bootstrap 95% lower bound of the difference > 0 (pooled 2023-2024, 400 replicates, seed 17), AND event recall >= static-list recall - 0.02; the same comparison with persistence is reported; object-block CI reported
criteria.sets: differences F2+sel - F2 and F2+W - F2 are exploration only: with one seed there is no noise estimate, so no claim of a gain is made; the v3 seed spread (up to 0.014 at precision about 0.15) is printed beside them as a noise reference
criteria.product_horizon: chosen by the user and the technologist from the final table; not chosen here
criteria.stop: after these 10 fits the run stops and reports
